notes.title: Penguins Arena is back!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

After months (well a complete year to be honest) with a broken game, I figure it out.
Everything was broken, master server was down and our two officials servers were offline too.
I'm glad to say that it's resolved now, bugs are fixed and I've put a few more coins in our webhosting so our servers can be online for a few more months.

Thanks for all your kind DM/mails. We don't answer everytime but make sure your messages got received <3  
Happy holidays, keep safe, wear your masks and [b]have fun[/b] with Penguins Arena.

ːBTeamː Mathieu

notes.title: New map, better AI + Farabel
notes.notes:
We're really happy to offer you this new update of Penguins Arena!
What's new?
[list]
    [*]a new map (for a total of 18 official maps)
    [*]we've rolled back our AI code a bit as the last update added some issues with our bots
[/list]

Today we're also releasing our new game, Farabel!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200

You can help us by telling your friends about our new game on Twitter/FB/... We're really proud of Farabel and we truly hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we've enjoyed making it!
And, you never know, if Farabel is a success maybe we'll finally have some time to work on Penguins Arena 2 :D

[quote][b]Farabel is a turn based strategy game in which you start at the end of the story. But that’s not all. In Farabel, the whole gaming experience is turned around.[/b]
You start out the adventure with a hero at maximum power, and with each jump into the past, your character is left with a slightly weaker body. At the same time, the game become more and more complexe. Develop your cleverness, your strategic prowess, and your inventive capabilities![/quote]

notes.title: Farabel
notes.notes:
My dear little penguins :BTeam:,

We'll be releasing a new game in the coming weeks: [url=http://farabel.com]Farabel[/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200

[h1]Farabel is a turn based strategy game that starts out at the end[/h1]

[b]You start out at the conclusion of the story. But that's not all. In Farabel, the whole gaming experience is turned around. You start out the adventure with a hero at maximum power, but your hero loses power with each battle. You don't choose which skill you want to reinforce. Instead, you have to decide which one to diminish. You don't develop your character. You develop your own gaming abilities, including your cleverness, strategic prowess, inventive capabilities, and your knowledge of the game.

To win at Farabel, being powerful means nothing. You have to be clever! And you have to get more and more clever as you go.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/647135/19bcb2fa14a7d841ca69da274465cb820dd1f585.png[/img]

[list]
    [*][url=http://farabel.com]Official website[/url]
    [*][url=https://twitter.com/FrogamesFarabel]@FrogamesFarabel[/url]
    [*][url=https://www.facebook.com/FrogamesFarabel/]Facebook page[/url]
    [*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/364200]Steam store page[/url]
[/list]


[h1]You can play Farabel before everyone else, take part in our weekly giveaway[/h1]
More information: [url=http://www.farabel.com/#get]farabel.com[/url]

During [b]September[/b] we're offering 5 keys each week to people helping us to spread the word about [b]Farabel[/b].

[url=http://www.farabel.com/#get][img]http://www.farabel.com/_external_files/images/visuel7_GiveAway.png[/img][/url]

To participate it's simple, post a tweet about our game including a link to [url=http://www.farabel.com]farabel.com[/url].

Each monday morning we'll be picking up 5 winners and contact them on Twitter.
Be creative! It could be a tweet about our trailer, some of our screenshot, our Steam page... anything, just don't forget to put a link to [url=http://www.farabel.com]farabel.com[/url].

notes.title: Penguins Arena 1.9
notes.notes:
The new version of Penguins Arena is officially live!

[list]
    [*]Dedicated servers (see below)
    [*]A new map
    [*]More brutal weapons
    [*]Lots of tweaks and bugs fixed
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/647135/776ec9d8d650b73ecacc19d2f9c1a2eca46a383a.gif[/img]

We were working on dedicated servers for a while now, you probably saw them if you played PA during last months.
There's two official dedicated servers, one is located in the USA (Dallas) the other one in Europe (Paris).
We have the liberty the bring new dedicated servers in just a few minutes so if there's a surge of players at some point we're ready!

We're testing some new AI on the dedicated servers, you'll probably cross them if you're playing online (their names start with a "SUPERBOT" tag). We'll update them as often as possible to bring more challenge to experienced players.

Now that we've tested our dedicated servers we're happy to give you the opportunity to host your own!
You can grab the last version of the dedicated server here (Win/Linux): http://frogames.com/penguins_arena/downloads/Penguins%20Arena%20DedicatedServer.zip There's a README file to guide you but more details will be posted on our forums soon.

[i]I hope you'll have as much fun as we had playing this new version![/i]
:BTeam: :GTeam: :RTeam: :YTeam:

notes.title: MiniOne Racing
notes.notes:
MiniOne Racing is our second game on Steam.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/380000

MiniOne Racing is a thrilling racing game which lets players drive colorful, humorous miniature vehicles around various locations created by a kid: beach, playground... and even other planet!

MiniOne Racing is first and foremost a single player game, but you can also race against friends. Remember to read this "[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/380000/discussions/0/523890046868907021/]how to[/url]" before hosting a multiplayer game.

MiniOne Racing might be an old game, but it's still a fun arcade playground for kids (and adults who just want a simple & fun racing game)!

notes.title: ULTIMATE PENGUIN FIGHTING is back!
notes.notes:
It's been 6 years since Penguins Arena was released on Steam, since then we were busy surviving and making indie games, but that's another story... The good news is that we've just got back control of our game on Steam from our former publisher. Others might have not care about an old game like PA, but we do! That's why we've been very busy working on an update for it, and now is time to release it.
[b]Yes, that's how much we loved this game![/b]

[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[list]
 [*]New price ($5.99)
 [*]Mac version
 [*]Online multiplayers games are working again
 [*]Steam trading cards
 [*]Less bugs, no more cheating
[/list]

That's the first step for us, we'd love to bring more maps/modes if more players are interested! Your help will be precious, the best gift you can give us is to spread to word to your friends, youtubers, twitchers... 

Thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoU7ZIUKiiWQMNnkYa9Q1Og]Money_Mouse[/url] we even got 2 more INSANE trailers for Penguins Arena. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_VS7f-CCRt0 & https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ePJ6aWrbH9Q
We can smell your brain burning from here.

Those who are really interested in Steam Achievements should read [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/11280/discussions/0/617336568086488854/]this thread[/url].

Last but not least we would like to thank all of you who are still playing Penguins Arena after all those years. Your support, your help for this update and your enthusiasm mean the world to us. YOU'RE AWESOME!

notes.title: An update is coming!
notes.notes:
Yeap, 6 years after its first release on Steam, Penguins Arena is getting an update!

You'll know more in a few days but first we have to announce a bad news: we'll have to unplug the Steam achievements. We're very sorry for that but the new version of PA is not compatible with Steam achievements anymore, as we think the update is more valuable for everyone we had to make this decision.

You'll still be able to unlock the in-game achievements but they will not be tight to Steam anymore.

See you in a few days for the good news!

notes.title: Discovering Colors on Greenlight
notes.notes:
We need your help to Greenlight [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=218521924]Discovering Colors - Animals[/url]

Discovering Colors - Animals is a coloring game featuring fun animals! It's aimed at young children, and is recommended for ages 2 to 5. 

We know this is not the typicial game you see on Greenlight but a lot of us have kids and we think that an app like ours can be a good introduction to computers for them.

[b]A vote for it would be greetly appreciated! <3[/b]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=218521924]Discovering Colors - Animals on Greenlight[/url].

In another news, 5 years after the release of Penguins Arena on Steam we still have an update in store for you. This will not be a piece of cake but we loved to find a way to push this update to you guys! Stay tuned.

notes.title: Penguins Arena 1.6.5 Update
notes.notes:
- Add the "Custom maps" game mode, which allow player to play maps created with the PAME (Penguins Arena Map Editor).
- Add 4 custom maps created by players  (Thank you Hugo, Cugel, Ekedens and iCreepy).
- Fixed: sometimes, penguins fall into the water but are still alive.
- Fixed: some achievements can't be unlocked.
- Fixed: the game crash when the player try to join a full server.
- Fixed: can't bind 'E' .
